mapper.select: SELECT VMVT.TMP_CODE tmpCode, VMVT.TMP_NAME tmpName, DETAIL.SUBJECT_NO subjectNo, DETAIL.SUBJECT_NAME subjectName, DETAIL.CD_FLAG cdFlag, DETAIL.CCY ccy, DETAIL.O_HAPPEN_AMT oHappenAmt, DETAIL.HAPPEN_NUMBER happenNumber FROM VAL_MANUAL_VOUCHER_TMP VMVT LEFT JOIN VAL_MANUAL_VOUCHER_TMP_DETAIL DETAIL ON VMVT.TMP_CODE =DETAIL.TMP_CODE WHERE VMVT.TMP_CODE = #{tmpCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
